Name: Simple Skill Bars
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][color=#ff0000][size=2][b]Description Page Update: 08-Oct-2026[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=6][b][color=#D8B4FE]✦ Simple Skill Bars ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][b][color=#A7F3D0]A small visual refresh for your Skills menu.[/color][/b][/center]

[center]Give your skills coloured nameplates, thick beveled XP bars and clear level badges. Keep vanilla and supported custom skills visually consistent while following their existing progression.[/center]

[center][b][color=#FDE68A]Made following a player request.[/color][/b] SSB is a simple cosmetic improvement for players who prefer this style of Skills page.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🌱 A clearer Skills page[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Vanilla skills[/color][/b]
Matching coloured nameplates, beveled XP bars and aligned level badges.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]SpaceCore skills[/color][/b]
Automatic styling using each registered skill’s own icon, colour, XP curve and level cap.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Mastery[/color][/b]
Matching green styling when native Mastery progress is available.[/quote][/center]
[center]Shorter nameplates keep vanilla, custom and Mastery rows aligned.[/center]

[center]Farming uses olive, Mining purple, Foraging green, Fishing blue and Combat red. Custom skills use their own registered colours and loaded artwork. Completed tracks stay full at the skill’s own cap.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]🌟 Professions at a glance[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Zero to two[/color][/b]
Compact milestone badges, including locked or pending choices. Vanilla milestones are levels 5 and 10.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Three or more[/color][/b]
That skill expands to show its actual owned profession icons. Other rows remain compact.[/quote][/center]
[center]Duplicate ownership counts once. Mouse and controller focus reveal profession details.
SSB displays professions; it does not grant them or change their effects.[/center]

[center]Custom skills use their registered profession milestones, icons and descriptions. Optional Skill Prestige ownership is read for display; prestige rules and point spending stay with Skill Prestige.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]⚙ Optional settings[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Enable Skill Bars[/color][/b]
On: use SSB’s display. Off: restore the display supplied by the game or supported SSE.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Show Skill Nameplates[/color][/b]
On: use coloured nameplates. Off: retain native skill names and icons while keeping SSB bars.[/quote][/center]
[center]Without GMCM, use the generated config.json for the same options.[/center]

[center][color=#67E8F9][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/color] provides the two in-game switches. All twelve built-in game languages are included.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#67E8F9]🧩 Compatibility[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Vanilla / SpaceCore[/color][/b]
Works standalone for the five vanilla skills and native Mastery. SpaceCore is needed only for skills supplied through SpaceCore. Visible registered skills are detected automatically; hidden skills stay hidden. Unsupported metadata keeps its original row.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Custom skill checks[/color][/b]
Cooking from Love of Cooking, SpaceCore Luck, Binning, Socializing and Travelling were checked using downloaded runtime types and authored XP curves/artwork in isolated rendering tests. Other skills using the supported SpaceCore registration can receive the same styling. Older non-SpaceCore Luck 1.2.6 keeps its original display.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Simple Skills Extended[/color][/b]
[color=#67E8F9][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53458]SSE[/url][/color] is optional. SSB reads existing extended levels, XP, prestige recovery and professions while retaining journal actions. Both Level 100 and Level 30 editions of SSE 1.10–1.16 were checked. No SSE update is required for those versions.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Simple Experience Bar[/color][/b]
[color=#67E8F9][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/53444]Simple Experience Bar[/url][/color] can be used alongside SSB. SSB styles the Skills menu; SEB provides the gameplay HUD bars.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]UI themes and replacements[/color][/b]
The hanging-label fix handles Simple UI Themes and Simple UI Themes 2 text rewriting. SSB uses loaded skill/profession artwork. Complete Skills-menu replacements or unfamiliar extended-skill displays may need separate integration.[/quote][/center]

[center]Compatibility checks used isolated game-rendering and runtime fixtures. Full modpack, physical-controller and multiplayer playtesting remain unverified.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#86EFAC]📦 Requirements and installation[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]• Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later.
• [color=#67E8F9][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI 4.4.0 or later[/url][/color].
• Optional: Generic Mod Config Menu, SpaceCore and SSE.[/center]

[center]1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download and extract Simple Skill Bars.
3. Place the [b]SimpleSkillBars[/b] folder inside your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.
4. Launch through SMAPI and open the Skills tab.[/center]

[center]Install the extracted folder, not the ZIP. Keep config.json when updating to retain your settings. Restart the game after replacing the mod files.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#D8B4FE]💬 Before you download[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Does this change skills or add rewards?[/color][/b]
No. SSB changes the display. It does not add XP, levels, professions, perks or rewards. Use it if you prefer this appearance.[/quote][/center]

[center][quote][b][color=#FDE68A]Can I remove it?[/color][/b]
Yes. SSB writes no save data. Remove its folder to return to the display supplied by the game and your remaining mods.[/quote][/center]

[center]The download includes the DLL, manifest and translations. No separate shared-library mod is needed.[/center]

[center][size=4][b][color=#FDE68A]🎨 Credits[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[center]Stardew Valley and its native artwork/fonts belong to ConcernedApe. SpaceCore and compatible skill mods supply their own registered icons and profession information; their assets and DLLs are not bundled with SSB.[/center]
